dict.string: FUEGO uses your fitness data to track progress and unlock milestone-based rewards. Your workout data helps you earn exclusive gear through verified achievements.
FUEGO may update your health data to record milestone achievements and fitness goals.
FUEGO uses the camera to scan QR codes for product authentication and special offers.
FUEGO uses your location to detect gym visits and award milestone progress for fitness center attendance.
FUEGO uses your location to automatically track gym visits and award milestone progress for fitness center attendance, even when the app is in the background.
